channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit and more, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Show HN: A free interactive course on AI agent governance
item.description: A free interactive course on AI agent governance you can take right in the browser — Module 1 needs no registration, learn by doing.

item.title: YopTools – Free, no-signup AI text tools (Humanizer, Detector, Summarizer, Google Review Reply Generator and more useful tools)
item.description: A free, no-signup collection of AI text tools: paste your text to humanize AI writing, detect AI content, or draft Google review replies, with natural Spanish phrasing.

item.title: Canvas by AgentGrid – An AI Agent Workspace for Design Files
item.description: Open a canvas in the browser, drop in Figma, web or document files, and connect Claude or other agents to work on your designs right there.

item.title: Show HN: Free AI Background Remover with Local Browser Privacy Mode (No Sign-Up)
item.description: Upload a photo and get a transparent cutout in seconds, with an on-device mode that never uploads your image — free, full-resolution, no sign-up or watermark.

item.title: I built AirTruth — a tool that cross-checks ADS-B radar and airport weather to bust fake airline "weather" delay excuses
item.description: Enter a flight number to cross-check radar, airport weather, and crew duty records for the real cause of a delay, and get a free compensation claim letter.

item.title: Show HN: OpenButterfly – Tracking the environmental impact of the AI ecosystem
item.description: An interactive map of AI data centers worldwide, covering 217 sites with their size, location, water stress and grid carbon intensity — every figure sourced and confidence-rated.

item.title: LexiCAD
item.description: Describe a part in plain language and an AI agent designs the CAD, checks it against your spec, and exports STEP, STL and 3MF files ready to print.

item.title: Show HN: AI Infra Finance tracker (Data-vis project)
item.description: A live dashboard tracking early warning signs of the AI build-out — big tech capex, borrowing costs, GPU rental prices and used-chip resale values — to judge whether the AI infrastructure boom is running ahead of itself.

item.title: Show HN: Softytools – 17 free trading calculators, no signup
item.description: Seventeen free trading calculators in one place — work out position size, risk and returns with no signup, right in the browser.

item.title: I built a full-stack web app that connects your vegetable garden to your freezer inventory and AI recipes (PlotToPlate - looking for beta feedback! 🌱❄️)
item.description: Plan your vegetable garden, label freezer stock with expiry dates, and let AI suggest recipes from what you already have — try the demo in your browser, no install needed.

item.title: Show HN: AI Dating photos – can you tell they're AI?
item.description: Upload a few selfies and get dating photos in 62 scenes in about a minute, plus free bio, opener and reply generators — nothing to install.

item.title: Memeo – Turn Static Photos into Lip-Synced AI Meme Videos
item.description: Upload one photo, pick a meme scene, and watch a person or pet lip-sync and act out a short skit — a shareable meme video in minutes.

item.title: OneKDP: AI Book and KDP Cover Generator
item.description: An AI book and KDP cover generator with editable interiors, full print covers and free KDP tools.

item.title: IdeaAize Free Online Tools: 50+ browser tools
item.description: More than 50 free browser utilities for PDFs, images, code and more — files are processed locally, nothing is uploaded, no account or watermark.

item.title: Show HN: GummyType – Free bubble letter generator with transparent PNG export
item.description: Turn any short phrase into glossy 3D bubble letters with six shapes and nine finishes, and export a transparent PNG — free, no sign-up, everything stays in your browser.

item.title: Puffin
item.description: Give your AI agent its own email address, Discord and Telegram seats and a calendar: it drafts replies from your documents and nothing goes out until you approve it.

item.title: Freebuff
item.description: A free AI coding agent with no subscription and no credits to watch, funded by ads, that works in your browser, on desktop, on your phone or in the terminal.

item.title: Growlog: An offline-first grow diary that keeps your data on your device
item.description: A free offline grow diary with target values, logs and diagnosis in one place — no account needed, and your data never leaves your device.

item.title: Taxonomap: An interactive map of biodiversity data from around the world
item.description: Explore species records from around the world on an interactive map — click any region to see its biodiversity data.

item.title: Building a simulated user that runs your PR and posts the video. Does this solve a real problem?
item.description: Every time you open a PR, an AI tester runs your app like a real user and posts back a recording, screenshots, and steps to reproduce any bug it finds.
